ayahs.text_ar: Fa inna ma al usri yusra
ayahs.transliteration: Fa inna ma al usri yusra
ayahs.translation_en: For indeed, with hardship will be ease.
Indeed, with hardship will be ease.

ayahs.text_ar: La yukallifu Allahu nafsan illa wusaha
ayahs.transliteration: La yukallifu Allahu nafsan illa wusaha
ayahs.translation_en: Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear.
And do not approach unlawful sexual intercourse.
